decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down until about 13:20 (range 12:20 to 14:20). Central is already truck-limited: loader inflow is 110 t/h against truck capacity of 91 t/h, so an extra loader at C590-09 adds almost nothing. Este has about 13 t/h of spare truck capacity (inflow 59, trucks 72). I lend LH-08 from the infrastructure heading DS-E569-01, which costs 0.4 oz/h, to E543-07 (8.3 g/t, 311 t). Travel is 0.33 h. The gain is about 13 t/h x 7.3 h x 8.3 g/t / 31.1 = 25 oz, less about 3 oz of development value. Norte has spare truck capacity but only one producing stope, and a reserve there can only be opened by a stopped stope's loader, so I skip it. LH-10 stays at the workshop.

Radio and CMMS agree on both failures (LH-01 back 12:20-14:20, LH-02 15:00-17:00). LH-10 is idle at the workshop, 0.33 h from C590-09 (16.5 g/t, 260 t): about 6.2 h x 30 t/h x 16.5/31.1 = ~98 oz. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading (0.4 oz/h) to C564-08 (9 g/t), 0.52 h away: about 6 h x 25.4 t/h gives ~44 oz gross against ~2.4 oz heading cost. Central has 309 t of 450 t stockpile and trucks at 91 t/h, so both loaders will hit the truck limit near 14:00, which I estimate cuts the LH-08 gain by about 30%. The critical-path LH-09 stays put (5.7 oz/h). No reserve activations, because no stope was stopped.
